# Started by Claude, 27 Nov 2026: second try of task/offline, from its first try (run 45720347631),
# applied as commit 97ed4c9 on the test branch claude/test-offline-base (npm run check's types and unit
# tests pass there: 778 tests). The first real run on the owner's Claude API credits, with Claude
# Sonnet 5.5. The review (26 Nov 2026) found the first try safe for people who never tap Download, and
# named the fixes below before it can go live.
model: anthropic/claude-sonnet-5-5
base: 97ed4c9110bb9e616f2c11da2dce402501e72a2f

The first try is already in this copy, and it works: someone who never taps Download gets no worker
and no cache, the worker's scope is the app's own folder (/starfarer/ on the developers' site, / on
the play testers' site), and the Earth-Moon check passed 10/10. Keep all of that. Fix these, with the
smallest change that does it, and keep every check of scripts/offline.mjs passing:

1. A failed file must not waste the download. In src/platform/offline.ts downloadOfflineCopy, the
   six worker loops run on after one throws, and the catch deletes the staging cache while they
   still write to it. Add a shared "failed" flag the loops check; retry each file up to 3 times
   with a short wait before giving up; and wait for all loops to settle before anything else.
   Then keep what was fetched: Download again carries on, fetching only the files the staging
   cache lacks (each still checked by its SHA-256). On an iPhone, locking the screen fails the
   fetches in flight, so stopping and carrying on is the normal case there.
2. A stopped download's staging cache must not be lost track of. When the panel loads: a partial
   copy of the current version is offered to carry on ("A download stopped at N MB of M: Download
   carries on"), with Remove to free its space; every other starfarer-offline-v-* cache that is
   not complete (no offline-copy.json), not the active one and not pinned by an open tab is
   deleted.
3. Two tabs downloading at once destroy each other's staging. Take a Web Locks lock
   (navigator.locks.request) around the download; where Web Locks are missing, say in plain words
   that another tab is downloading and do nothing.
4. After an update the old copy is never pruned (prune runs only on "activate"). Run prune when
   the worker starts and when a page loads, so the old ~941 MB copy goes once no tab pins it.
5. Opening More fetches offline-manifest.json (about 1.5 MB) every time, before any opt-in. Read
   the cached status first; fetch the manifest only when Download is tapped (or when a copy is
   already kept, to offer an update).
6. Plain words for errors: never show String(error). A quota error says "Not enough room on this
   device for the offline copy"; a network failure says "The download stopped (no connection?).
   Download again to carry on"; anything else "The offline copy could not be made".
7. Ship a kill switch: public/sw-off.js, a worker that deletes every starfarer-offline cache and
   unregisters itself, and a sentence in HANDOFF.md on how to put it in place of sw.js if sw.js
   ever misbehaves.

Do not change anything else. In REPORT.md, list each fix with the check that shows it.
